name: Loan Applicant
description: A prospect applying for installment credit, not yet a customer.

name: Card Scheme
description: The network carrying authorization and clearing. An external system we integrate with on their terms, not ours, which is why their availability is a design constraint rather than a requirement.

name: Cardholder
description: The customer. Uses the self-service channels, and is the reason the authorization path has a latency budget rather than a throughput one.

name: Collections Agent
description: Handles arrears treatment and payment arrangements.

name: Merchant
description: Accepts the card at point of sale. Reached through the scheme, never directly.

name: Merchant Onboarding Analyst
description: Reviews a merchant's application and the documents behind it before the account opens.

name: Regulator
description: Consumes periodic regulatory returns. Never integrates directly; the relationship is a reporting obligation with a deadline.

name: Screening Analyst
description: Works the alert queue: clears the false positives and escalates the rest. The queue exists because the screening does, and its volume is the number the vendor's tuning is judged on.

name: Servicing Agent
description: Contact center staff handling balance, dispute and account queries.

name: Credit Underwriter
description: Reviews referred applications the automated decision would not take.
